translation.question: Ni wimbo gani ambao Aya Nakamura aliutumbuiza katika mchanganyiko pamoja na "Djadja" kwenye sherehe za ufunguzi wa Michezo ya Olimpiki ya Majira ya Joto ya 2024?

backtranslation_en.question: Which song did Aya Nakamura perform in a medley together with "Djadja" at the opening ceremony of the 2024 Summer Olympics?
